project.name: AERF - End-to-End Pipeline
project.description: The ExtractionAdapter Plan's Increment 16 entry point: extraction (aerf-openrewrite) -> role inference -> the four MVP entropy metrics -> invariant evaluation -> calibration/aggregation -> JSON reporting (aerf-report), composed into one runnable pipeline over real Java source. Depends transitively on OpenRewrite through aerf-openrewrite, so - like aerf-openrewrite itself - carries no maven-enforcer ban; the four modules that must never see OpenRewrite (aerf-model, aerf-analysis, aerf-report, aerf-extraction) enforce that independently of this module's own dependencies.
